$description: CopyButton (platform/components/CopyButton, library wave 5, lane B): its component tokens. The button is a Button (its variant, size and states); the field is an Input in the data font.

copy-button-field-max-width.$description: CopyButton field: the widest the field and its button grow (the large field width).

copy-button-field-joined-radius.$description: CopyButton field: the square corners where the field meets the button (as a button group's joined corners).

copy-button-field-focus-layer.$description: CopyButton field: the focused button rises one layer so its focus ring is drawn over the field's edge.
